notes: This report uses the identical 4096-token FineWeb-Edu batch and seed as h100_liger_real_text.json.
Actual torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(parameters, 1.0, error_if_nonfinite=True) was called after every backward pass; clipping was not approximated.
All 232 raw and clipped parameter-gradient tensors were compared. The isolated Liger path passed both comparisons with identical loss.
Liger RMSNorm and RoPE functions were replaced with failing sentinels during this check to verify they were never called.
The compiled path remains available but fails raw and per-parameter clipped gradient parity; use compile_kernels=False for the validated configuration.
No optimizer was constructed or stepped on GPU. CPU tests verify clipping before real AdamW steps.
One warmup and three measured passes per mode. Timings include forward/backward and actual clipping, excluding CPU gradient copies and diagnostic norm reductions.
FP64 was used only for diagnostic reductions. Parameters, activations and gradient clipping use FP32.
A passing comparison on this batch and seed does not establish convergence or general long-stream stability.
